title: Side Chats and Conversation Search
description: Cursor 3.11 adds side chats, letting developers branch off a quick question or tangent via /side or /btw without losing the main agent thread's context. The release also ships conversation search across a local index of past agent sessions, a redesigned project and repo picker, and new hooks for observing and controlling cloud agent conversations.

title: Sam Altman seeks new world order for AI as OpenAI slowly loses ground to Google and Anthropic
description: Sam Altman is pushing for a global AI safety governance framework modeled on aviation and atomic-energy standards, even as OpenAI cedes ground: ChatGPT's market share has fallen below 50% for the first time as Anthropic gains on revenue and engagement. The piece also notes that AI productivity gains remain concentrated in tech companies, with adoption in non-tech sectors moving slowly.
